summary: Iter53 — Retest of SB Drive VTC admin FR localization, Phase 2 aliases, driver endpoints, admin CRUD, and cross-flows (follow-up to iter52 macro audit). ALL 30 backend tests pass. Frontend spot-check of admin dashboard verifies: SB Drive brand replaced XJEKPLUS, all 12 French section labels present in sidebar (ACCUEIL/MEMBRES/SERVICES/RÉSERVATIONS & RAPPORTS/PORTEFEUILLE & PAIEMENTS/RÉCOMPENSES & FIDÉLITÉ/LOCALISATION/PROMOTIONS & MARKETING/CMS/SUPPORT/PARAMÈTRES & UTILITAIRES/SYSTÈME), Banners page shows 3 seeded rows with Ajouter/Désactiver/Delete actions, Payout page shows 4 seeded rows (paid + pending), /admin/payment-options correctly shows 'Configuration bientôt disponible' placeholder (no more Genie fall-through). All iter52 P0 blockers are resolved.

minor.issue: Expects body either flat or wrapped as {settings:{...}}; GET returns {settings:{...}}. Minor API shape asymmetry but functional.
Requires 'iban' field (not 'method'). Frontend must send iban. Returns 400 insufficient balance for wallets with 0 balance — endpoint itself is wired correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Page header 'Driver Payouts' is in English while brief asks full French localization. Sidebar labels are French but individual page H1 titles like 'Driver Payouts' remain English on /admin/payout. 'Bannières publicitaires' is correctly French.

Page loads but explicit buttons labelled 'Approuver'/'Refuser' not detected in visible text; likely using generic CRUD pencil/trash icons instead of status-transition buttons. Functional but less explicit than brief suggested.

design_issues.screen: Sidebar sub-items (e.g., 'Taxi / Transport', 'Parcel Delivery', 'Delivery Genie', 'Manage Rewards', 'Nearby Management')
issues: Top-level section labels are French but sub-menu items under services remain in English — inconsistent with stated FR localization goal. Non-blocking.

action_items: P2: Localize remaining admin page H1 titles ('Driver Payouts' -> 'Versements Chauffeurs', etc.) and sub-menu item labels to French.

P2: If UX needs explicit status-transition buttons (Approuver/Refuser, Investiguer/Résoudre, Verser), add them to AdminWalletRequests / AdminDisputes / AdminSettlements / AdminDocuments instead of relying solely on the generic CRUD edit dialog.
P3: Normalize /api/admin/settings request/response shape (GET returns {settings:{}}, PUT accepts either) — doc the chosen contract and keep consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminServiceConfig.js fall-through bug is fixed — unknown service keys now render a typed 'Configuration bientôt disponible' placeholder instead of silently defaulting to the Genie form. Good.

ALLOWED_CRUD in routes/admin.py now correctly includes banners, wallet_requests, promocodes, news, newsletter_subscribers, payouts, settlements, disputes, documents — 47% placeholder problem from iter52 is effectively resolved at the API layer.
Seed data in server.py startup creates realistic demo rows (3 banners, 4 payouts, 3 settlements, 3 disputes, 3 wallet-requests, 3 documents) which makes the admin pages demonstrable end-to-end.
Phase 2 alias endpoints (/loyalty/me, /referral/me, /subscriptions/plans, /safety/emergency-contacts, /favorites/drivers) all return 200 — driver/user app contract gap from iter52 closed.
Driver endpoints (/my-stats, /my-earnings, /my-documents, /my-notifications, /incoming-requests) all return 200 with driver token — another iter52 P0 blocker resolved.

success_rate.backend: 100% (30/30 pytest cases passing — admin core + settings + CRUD for 6 collections + promocodes + 5 phase2 aliases + 5 driver endpoints + cross-flows)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (admin login, sidebar brand+FR labels, Banners, Payouts, Disputes, Wallet-Requests, Promocodes, Payment-Options placeholder all verified; remaining concerns are cosmetic page titles and sub-menu labels in English)
